event: Sep 2023 Western Cape cut-off low floods (Cape Town, Overberg)
evidence: The President would like to extend his sympathies to all the people who have been affected by the recent floods in the Western Cape.
notes: No report found of an on-site visit. The Presidency responded with a spokesperson's statement from the Union Buildings in Pretoria (27 Sep 2023). No reason was given for not visiting. Wikipedia's 2023 Western Cape floods page does not mention any national-level visit.

evidence: We gather here in the province of the Western Cape in the aftermath of ferocious and unforgiving storms that caused damage to homes, businesses and infrastructure, affecting tens of thousands of people across the province.
notes: Ramaphosa was in Cape Town on 18 Jul 2024 for the Opening of Parliament Address and mentioned the storms in it. That is not a site visit, and no report of him visiting affected communities was found. Premier Winde led the provincial oversight visits (SAnews: 'Western Cape Premier leads oversight visits to storm-hit areas').

event: May 2026 Western Cape / Garden Route cut-off low (national disaster declared)
evidence: In a statement on Monday night
dp_evidence: No report found of a flood visit. Mashatile made an oversight visit to the Cape Flats (Mitchells Plain, Gugulethu) on 27 May 2026, but it was about the SANDF anti-gang deployment, not the floods: https://www.ewn.co.za/2026/05/27/mashatile-conducts-cape-flats-oversight-visit-in-cape-flats
nearest_election: Local government elections due late 2026 (exact date not verified here); last national 29 May 2024
notes: No report found. The disaster covered six provinces (WC, NW, FS, EC, NC, MP). Daily Maverick (27 Jul 2026) quotes an 11 May 2026 Ramaphosa statement and mentions no visit.

provincial_government: DA (Western Cape: Garden Route/Karoo); ANC (Eastern Cape: Kouga/Humansdorp)
nearest_election: Local government elections due late 2026 (date not verified here)
notes: No report found. Around 4 Jun 2026 Ramaphosa was hosting Kenyan President Ruto on a state visit (eNCA news bite).
No report found. Coverage mentions only provincial and local officials and an offer of Presidency assistance. This is an ANC-governed province with no visit, which weakens the ANC-only framing.

provincial_government: ANC (caretaker; the IFP-led GNU under Premier Ntuli took office mid-June 2024)
notes: No report found. This was the same storm complex as the Gqeberha/Kariega floods, and Ramaphosa visited Gqeberha (EC) on 7 Jun 2024 instead (thepresidency.gov.za 'President Ramaphosa to undertake oversight visit to Gqeberha to assess response to weather-induced emergencies'). The social development minister and a KZN MEC visited Tongaat. The storm hit during the post-election government-formation period.

event: Jan 2022 Eastern Cape (Mdantsane / Buffalo City) floods
dp_evidence: No report found. Mabuza answered questions in the National Assembly on the floods in June 2022 (News24 20220608), but no site visit was found.
notes: No report found. Ministers and Premier Mabuyane visited. An ANC-governed province with no presidential visit.

event: Feb 2023 national disaster floods (LP, MP, NW, KZN, EC, NC, FS)
evidence: President Cyril Ramaphosa declared on February 13 the State of National Disaster in seven provinces.
dp_evidence: no report found (Mabuza was DP until 7 Mar 2023)
notes: No report of a Feb 2023 site visit was found. The Mpumalanga (Nkomazi) and Limpopo (Vhembe/Mopani) visit reports that come up in searches are dated Jan 2026, not 2023. The follow-on Mar 2023 Port St Johns visit (28 Mar 2023) was already coded.

dp_evidence: A search-engine summary of a News24 special project said Ramaphosa (then Deputy President) toured Durban with Mayor Gumede, but the page returned 403 and could not be verified. The Gumede tour documented elsewhere is April 2019.
notes: President was Zuma. No report found of a Zuma visit.

evidence: President Jacob Zuma accompanied by Gauteng Premier David Makhura and Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs Minister Des van Rooyen inspected the area and homes that were washed away.
notes: The president visiting was Zuma, not Ramaphosa. This contradicts the earlier coding of no visit.
No report found. This was a localised flash-flood incident, and the ANC national conference was 16-20 Dec 2022.

event: ADDITIONAL (not in prior coding): Jan 2026 Mpumalanga (Nkomazi) floods
evidence: President Cyril Ramaphosa is this afternoon visiting Nkomazi Local Municipality in Mpumalanga to assess the extent of the damage caused by the floods and the response of government.
notes: A second Jan 2026 visit, separate from Limpopo (Vhembe/Mopani, reported 16 Jan 2026: https://www.sanews.gov.za/south-africa/damage-caused-limpopo-floods-catastrophic-says-president).
